datasets.title: S2 L1C - T32TPS 2025-04-12
datasets.description: converted/sentinel-2-l1c, 13 bands. Pick a level group: 20 (10 m bands), 19 (20 m bands), 17 (60 m bands).

datasets.title: S2 L2A - Paris T31UDQ 2025-06-13
datasets.description: converted/sentinel-2-l2a. Pick a level group: 20 (10 m bands), 19 and 17 (native bands plus the ESA resampled copies).

datasets.title: S2 L1C multires - T32TPS 2025-04-12
datasets.description: converted/sentinel-2-l1c-multires/mean-l20-l12. Experimental: each band starts at its native level, coarser levels are the mean of the finer one. Pick the level (12-20) by hand here; switching with the zoom needs d70-t/gridlook#235.

datasets.title: S3 OLCI EFR - 2026-01-17
datasets.description: converted/sentinel-3-olci-l1-efr: one granule, HEALPix level 15. Large: takes about a minute and over 1 GB of memory to load.

datasets.title: S3 SLSTR RBT - 2026-01-07 night
datasets.description: converted/sentinel-3-slstr-l1-rbt: night granule, opens on the S8 brightness temperature (10.85 um, nadir); the radiance bands are empty at night.

datasets.title: S3 synergy reprocessed - 2026-09-15
datasets.description: reprocessed/sentinel-3-synergy: OLCI and SLSTR radiances of one overpass on a common HEALPix level 15 grid. Large: takes about a minute and over 1 GB of memory to load.
